Lighthouse

An offshore climbing site with a hidden mine and high-tier loot.

What to do

The official route involves three levers, a hidden mine, collecting loot and escaping against a timer.

Main rewards

High-tier loot rewards careful exploration and a planned return route.

Risks

Climbing and timed escape are hazards; other players may contest the exit.

Recycler

For recycling, visit a gas station, parking lot, town, warehouse, Lumberjack or Miner.
